children: Diginex agreed to extend the deadline for completing its proposed Resulticks acquisition from Oct. 30 to Nov. 19, 2026. Closing conditions were unmet by the original deadline; the deal remains subject to remaining conditions, with no assurance of completion.
The acquisition remains unresolved after conditions were missed by the original Oct. 30 deadline; the extension preserves the deal but adds execution risk.
Shareholders will vote on capital authorization and a 10-for-1 share consolidation, which may proceed whether or not the acquisition closes.

This is a mid-cycle update to the proposed Resulticks acquisition, following shareholder approval in October but with closing conditions still outstanding. Completion depends on satisfying or waiving the remaining SPA conditions by the extended deadline, while shareholders must separately vote on the EGM proposals.
Based on the original press release from Diginex Limited distributed by GlobeNewswire.
